method: Represent public video-to-video mentions or explicitly credited remixes as directed links supported by on-page evidence, after verifying publication times and retaining selection/censoring. A directed reference is not the origin of a meme or audience transfer.
unit_of_analysis: publicly visible source video referencing another public video at a dated snapshot, not an identifiable audience member
selection_and_privacy: Link only from a specific public video to a specifically named or linked public target, not visually similar tropes or a keyword match.
Retain source URL and observation timestamp, excerpt locator, and rights/permission notes; do not reproduce media or comments.
Crawl or record only permissible public page metadata; no API quota abuse, bulk user profiling, commenter handles or private watch histories.
For dated references, distinguish target published before referring video; contemporaneous formal collaboration is not evidence of source origin.
Include unlinked source videos, deleted/inaccessible nodes and denominator selection in a real panel to avoid only successful references.
Document cross-format, language, geography and reporting dates before comparing public link incidence.
A graph edge is a public citation, not measured subscriber/viewer migration or causal recommendation lift.
